novelty_method: The complete 3670-label chain was reconstructed from the immutable 3530-row Neris index plus seven exact twenty-row freezes through Sable v662-v8. Historical title-or-description fields were normalized with explicit UTF-8. Exact collision, token-neighbour and domain-keyword review rejected apiary, ceramic, bicycle, handloom, darkroom, theatre, planetarium, dry-stone and change-ringing collisions. Cave and speleological domain terms had no inherited practice-lens collision; shared workflow words remain structural neighbours rather than novelty credit. Selected inherited rows remain zero-credit context.
selection_credit: Twenty Sable rows are selected for boundary revalidation only. They receive zero Caelen novelty, execution or completion credit.
